newsitem.title: MEXICO: Farben plans to enter money transfer mkt.
newsitem.headline: Farben plans to enter money transfer mkt.

text.p: Retail chain Farmacias Benavides (Farben) is planning to make inroads into the lucrative U.S.-Mexico money transfer business, a company spokesman said on Wednesday.

"We are looking into and will probably do it. It is a product which we see in terms of its potential $6 billion (total remittances per year)," Farben Banking Relations Manager Fernando Abrego said in a telephone interview.

Mexican workers in the United States send an estimated $6 billion to relatives in Mexico per year, one of the country's largest sources of foreign currency. Farben has 550 retail outlets across Mexico in which it could offer money transfer services.
Abrego calculated that 35 percent of total remittances were sent by direct wire transfers, a market worth $2.1 billion per year that Benavides seeks to tap.
